review_candidates.title: Operations Manager I Heavy Industries I Hanoi
review_candidates.description: The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing, directing, and optimizing all daily plant operations within our heavy industry facility. This role focuses on ensuring maximum production efficiency, strict safety compliance (HSE), cost management, and continuous improvement while leading a diverse team of engineers, technicians, and floor workers. Core Responsibilities Plant Production & Efficiency Direct and manage daily production activities to ensure output meets or exceeds targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules. Optimize capacity utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) across heavy machinery and production lines. Coordinate scheduled shutdowns and preventative maintenance programs with the engineering team to minimize costly downtime. Safety, Health, & Environment (HSE) Enforce an absolute culture of safety , ensuring 100% compliance with local industrial regulations and company HSE policies. Lead incident investigations , conduct root-cause analyses, and implement corrective actions for any safety breaches or near-misses. Monitor environmental impact and waste management to ensure compliance with sustainability guidelines. Cost Control & Financial Management Manage the operations budget (OPEX) , controlling labor costs, raw material consumption, and utility expenditures. Evaluate and justify capital expenditures (CAPEX) for technology upgrades, capacity expansions, or machinery replacement. Leadership & Workforce Management Provide strong leadership to shift supervisors, engineers, and plant operators, fostering high morale and accountability. Identify skill gaps and implement rigorous training programs for heavy equipment operation and technical compliance. Collaborate with HR on performance evaluations, labor relations, and succession planning. Continuous Improvement Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or 5S methodologies to eliminate bottlenecks, reduce waste, and streamline heavy industry workflows. Implement automated data tracking and utilize ERP systems to make data-driven operational decisions. At least 3–5 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical understanding of heavy machinery, automated control systems (SCADA/DCS), and industrial maintenance. Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or Project Management (PMP) are highly desirable. Strong crisis management and problem-solving skills under high-pressure environments. Excellent communication and negotiation skills to handle both floor workers and executive stakeholders.

review_candidates.title: Operations Coordinator
review_candidates.description: About IRIS IRIS Software Group is one of the UK's largest privately held software companies, trusted by 100,000+ businesses, schools and accountancy firms to keep their operations running. Our software pays 1 in 6 UK employees, supports over 12,000 schools, and is relied on by 91 of the top 100 UK accountancy firms. We're a Great Place to Work® certified employer, recognised for our commitment to well-being, inclusion and development - and we're growing fast. At IRIS, we help organisations around the world pay their employees accurately, securely and on time. Behind every successful international payroll is a team of people making sure everything happens exactly when it should. That's where this opportunity comes in. We're looking for an organised, proactive and detail-focused International Payroll Operations Advisor to join our growing International Payroll team. This isn't a payroll processing role. Instead, you'll become the person who keeps everything moving behind the scenes - coordinating new client onboarding, managing operational data, working with colleagues across multiple countries, supporting payment deadlines and making sure every part of the operation runs smoothly. If you enjoy organisation, solving problems, working with data and being the person who keeps everyone on track, we'd love to hear from you. 📍Location This is a remote role , but you'll need to be based in the South or South East of England . Our team gets together once a month , either at our Heathrow Approach office or in Chichester , so you'll need to be within reasonable travelling distance of one of these locations. The rest of your time can be worked remotely. 🧾 Why This Role Matters International payroll is all about precision. Every customer setup, every piece of information, every deadline and every process matters. As an International Payroll Operations Advisor, you'll play a key role in making sure our customers receive a seamless service from day one. You'll coordinate activity across multiple internal teams, maintain accurate operational data and help ensure payroll services are delivered successfully across more than 50 countries. It's a role where your organisation, attention to detail and ability to juggle multiple priorities genuinely make a difference every single day. 👥 About the Team You'll Join You'll join a close-knit team of six International Payroll Operations Advisors , led by an experienced International Business Operations Manager. Although this is a remote role, we're big believers in staying connected. The team comes together once a month for collaboration, planning and knowledge sharing, meeting either at our Heathrow Approach office or in Chichester . The rest of the time, you'll work remotely alongside colleagues based across the South of England. 📊 What You'll Be Doing No two days are quite the same, but you'll spend your time: Coordinating customer onboarding and ensuring everything is ready before payroll services begin. Maintaining accurate customer and operational information across multiple systems. Managing client contracts and onboarding data. Producing KPI and SLA reports accurately and on time. Reconciling implementation data to ensure complete accuracy. Supporting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) operational activities. Working closely with Payroll Operations, Commercial teams and external partners across multiple countries. Coordinating activity across several workstreams to keep projects moving and deadlines on track. Identifying opportunities to improve processes and make the team even more efficient. Helping deliver an excellent customer experience by ensuring everything happens accurately and on schedule. 🔎 What We’re Looking For This role is perfect for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity. You'll probably be a great fit if you have experience as an: Operations Coordinator Operations Administrator Payroll Administrator looking to move away from payroll processing Payroll Operations Coordinator Project Coordinator Project Support Coordinator Finance Administrator Payments Administrator Banking Administrator Client Services Administrator Customer Operations Coordinator We're Particularly Interested In People Who Have Experience working in an operations administration or coordination role. Strong organisational and multitasking skills. Excellent Excel skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and data. Experience using CRM systems. Great attention to detail. Confidence managing multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships across different teams. A professional approach to handling confidential information. A customer-first mindset. Experience within payroll, payments or financial services would be highly beneficial, but it's not essential. What's more important is your ability to coordinate multiple activities, stay organised and work accurately in a fast-paced operational environment. Candidates from finance, banking, payments, project support and similar administrative backgrounds have all transferred successfully into this type of role. 🚀 Why Apply? This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of the UK's leading software businesses while developing specialist experience within international payroll operations. You'll Benefit From Working with customers and colleagues across the globe. A varied role where no two days are the same. A supportive team that enjoys sharing knowledge and helping each other succeed. The opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in international payroll operations. A clear opportunity to progress into a Senior Operations Advisor role as you build your experience. The chance to build a long-term career within a growing international business. If you're someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys working with people, loves spreadsheets almost as much as solving problems, and takes pride in getting the details right, you'll fit right in. 📝 What Can You Expect From Our Application Process? Our process is designed to help you understand the role, meet the team and show us how you think. 1️⃣Initial conversation with Talent Acquisition A first conversation to talk through your experience, what you’re looking for next, and whether the role feels like the right fit. 2️⃣Competency interview with the International Business Operations Manager We'll explore your organisational skills, attention to detail, experience managing multiple priorities and how you've worked with different teams to keep things running smoothly. 3️⃣Final interview with the International Business Operations Manager and another manager from the International Payroll team A more in-depth conversation about the role, the team and how your experience could help you succeed, with plenty of opportunity for you to ask questions too. If you're looking for a role where organisation, accuracy and teamwork genuinely make an impact, and you want to build a long-term career in international payroll operations, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us deliver exceptional payroll services to customers around the world. Why You’ll Love Working Here Impact: Your work will influence millions globally. Growth: Continuous learning and career development opportunities. Belonging: A culture that celebrates diversity and empowers every individual. Ready to Apply? Click Apply - we’re excited to learn about your unique perspective and experience. If you need adjustments during the process, let us know. We’re committed to making this opportunity accessible to everyone. What To Expect From Our Hiring Process Our process is designed to be fair, transparent and straightforward. Stages vary depending on the role — more senior positions may involve additional steps, and some areas include role-specific assessments such as a technical test or case study — but typically you can expect: Application review — we assess your experience and potential Initial call — a short conversation to learn about you and share more about the role Skills assessment — tailored to the position, e.g. case study, coding challenge or portfolio review Final interview — meet the team and explore how you'll make an IMPACT at IRIS We'll always walk you through the specific stages at the start of the process so you can prepare with confidence. If you need any adjustments or accommodations during the process, let us know, we’re committed to making this experience accessible for everyone.

review_candidates.title: Machinebouwer Assemblage gezocht in Veldhoven
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Bouw mee aan hightech machines van wereldklasse Ben jij graag met techniek bezig en werk je nauwkeurig? Als Assembler / Machinebouwer in de regio Veldhoven bouw je mee aan geavanceerde machines die wereldwijd worden ingezet binnen de hightech industrie. In deze functie ben je dagelijks bezig met het samenstellen van complexe modules en systemen. Je werkt aan producten waarbij kwaliteit en precisie centraal staan. Samen met collega's uit engineering en productie zorg je ervoor dat alles perfect werkt voordat de machine de werkplaats verlaat. Wat ga je doen? Assembleren van hoogwaardige machineonderdelen en modules. Werken aan de hand van technische tekeningen en werkinstructies. Controleren, meten en testen van samengestelde onderdelen. Signaleren en oplossen van technische afwijkingen. Vastleggen van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden. Samenwerken met engineers, monteurs en andere technische specialisten. Actief meedenken over verbeteringen in het productieproces. Waarom jij hier wilt werken Je komt terecht in een innovatieve omgeving waar techniek en kwaliteit samenkomen. Je werkt met moderne apparatuur, leert de nieuwste technieken binnen de machinebouw en ziet iedere dag direct resultaat van jouw werk. Daarnaast krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, nieuwe vaardigheden te leren en mee te bouwen aan technologie die wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Functie-eisen Wie ben jij? Jij bent iemand die graag met techniek bezig is en energie krijgt van het bouwen van machines. Je houdt van afwisselend werk, denkt in oplossingen en bent pas tevreden als alles tot in detail klopt. Of je nu al ervaring hebt in de machinebouw of toe bent aan een volgende stap in je technische carrière, jouw enthousiasme en leergierigheid maken het verschil. Wat neem je mee? Een mbo-diploma richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica, Automotive of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring met assemblage, montage of machinebouw is mooi meegenomen. Je kunt technische tekeningen en werkinstructies lezen en begrijpen. Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit. Je denkt praktisch en lost technische uitdagingen graag op. Je werkt prettig samen met collega's en communiceert helder. Je beheerst de Nederlandse en/of Engelse taal. Waarom jij past bij deze functie Je hoeft niet alles al te weten. Veel belangrijker vinden wij dat je nieuwsgierig bent, initiatief toont en jezelf wilt blijven ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de kans om te werken aan innovatieve machines, nieuwe technieken te leren en je technische vaardigheden verder uit te bouwen. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Natuurlijk mag daar ook iets moois tegenover staan. Je komt terecht in een innovatieve werkomgeving waar techniek, ontwikkeling en werkplezier hand in hand gaan. Een salaris tussen €3.000 en €4.550 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring. Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en een passende pensioenregeling. Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en trainingen. Werken aan hoogwaardige machines binnen de internationale hightech industrie. Een moderne werkomgeving met de nieuwste technieken en gereedschappen. Volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien richting specialistische of coördinerende functies. Een informeel team waarin collega's elkaar helpen en kennis delen. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen jouw functie. Uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren. Jouw volgende stap Zoek jij een baan waarin je werkt aan innovatieve technologie, jezelf blijft ontwikkelen én goed wordt beloond voor jouw vakmanschap? Dan is deze functie als Assembler / Machinebouwer in Veldhoven dé kans om je technische carrière naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Info over het bedrijf ASML is een gerenommeerd hightech bedrijf dat zijn oorsprong vindt in 1984 als een dochteronderneming van Philips. Als wereldleider op het gebied van lithografiemachines speelt ASML een cruciale rol in de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde technologieën. Deze machines worden wereldwijd ingezet door vooraanstaande bedrijven zoals Samsung en Intel om chips te produceren voor diverse digitale toepassingen, waaronder smartphones, tablets en gps-systemen. Met zijn voortdurende focus op kennis en innovatie fungeert ASML als een drijvende kracht achter de vooruitgang in de technische sector. Elke dag wordt er gewerkt aan het creëren van een betere, efficiëntere en schonere toekomst. Bij ASML kom je terecht in een gezonde en mensgerichte werkomgeving, waar je de mogelijkheid krijgt om je ambities waar te maken. Het bedrijf biedt een stimulerende omgeving waarin talent wordt gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd.

review_candidates.title: HR Offer Specialist
review_candidates.description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. Job Description Are you ready to grow your HR career in an international environment? As HR Offer Specialist, you will help manage and coordinate internal offers, draft contracts, and oversee documentation. You will provide support on various HR-related tasks for employees in the corporate office in Brussels, Belgium, and other Eurofins companies across the network. You will be directly involved in preparing Belgian employment offers and contracts, putting together compensation and benefits packages, and ensuring internal validation of these offers. This includes collaborating with our Payroll, Compensation and Benefits, and Tax teams to draft net salary simulations. Initially focused on validating standard international offers, the role provides the opportunity to gradually take on more specialised and complex offers over time. You will also be responsible for ensuring employee files are accurate and up-to-date, acting as the main contact for HR-related inquiries from staff in the corporate office in Brussels, Belgium. Additionally, you will help coordinate the implementation of recruitment software and assist with transforming HR processes. Other duties include the review of internship agreements and V.I.E (Volontariat International en Entreprise) programme applications and collaborating with universities and Business France representatives to manage contracts. As part of the Offer Team, you’ll play a key role in improving workflows, templates, and internal guidelines to help streamline operations and ensure consistency. This is a full-time position based in Brussels, Belgium. Starting date: As soon as possible. What can we do for you? You will join an international office ideally located near parks and green spaces, bringing together colleagues from over 35 nationalities. Additionally, we offer an attractive compensation package and extra-legal benefits that include covered transportation costs, organic meals, sports activities, and annual office events. In addition, you will have the chance to work closely with experienced HR and Talent Acquisition professionals, and gain exposure to a global network with growth opportunities. Qualifications Are you our kind of extraordinary? You have a master’s degree in business administration or a related field from a top university. You have at least 2 years of work experience in a related field (Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, Tax, HR, etc.)You speak excellent English, which will be your main language of communication. Knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and can handle both large tasks and smaller details. You are comfortable using Microsoft Office and working in a digital environment. Additional Information We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development. We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal! Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

review_candidates.description: Description As General Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them, and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky, and pioneering wellness. Sustainability, wellness, and out of the ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars through strategic planning and execution, ensuring all initiatives are fully embedded across the resort. As the leader of Six Senses Zighy Bay, I will drive the positioning of the resort as a leading ultra-luxury destination in the Middle East, delivering highly personalized guest experiences within a complex and remote operating environment, while maintaining the highest brand standards and owner expectations. Duties And Responsibilities As General Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the resort to provide exceptional products and services in line with Six Senses brand standards and financial objectives. The duties and responsibilities will include: ▪ Lead the overall operation and positioning of Six Senses Zighy Bay as a benchmark ultra-luxury resort in the Middle East. ▪ Drive a highly personalized villa-based guest experience, ensuring exceptional service delivery aligned with elevated guest expectations and brand standards. ▪ Foster an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing culture, with a strong focus on attracting, developing, and retaining talent in a remote location environment. ▪ Ensure full alignment with Six Senses operational standards across all departments, maintaining and exceeding performance benchmarks. ▪ Instill a strong commercial mindset across the team, driving revenue through high ADR strategies, premium experiences, and wellness offerings, while maintaining cost discipline and operational efficiencies. ▪ Oversee the strategic direction of sales, marketing, and PR to strengthen brand positioning across key GCC and international markets. ▪ Manage operational complexity across villas, dining concepts, wellness, and logistics, ensuring seamless delivery of guest experiences. ▪ Champion sustainability and regenerative practices, including Earth Lab initiatives, local sourcing, and on-site production, embedding these into daily operations and guest engagement. ▪ Ensure compliance with all legal, financial, health and safety, and regulatory requirements, including regional considerations and visa limitations impacting the workforce. ▪ Build and maintain strong relationships with ownership and key stakeholders, aligning on performance, operational priorities, and long-term strategic direction. ▪ Respect and uphold Omani traditions and Islamic culture, ensuring cultural sensitivity is embedded in both guest and host experiences. Qualifications To execute the position of General Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role within ultra-luxury resort environments, including: ▪ Proven experience as a General Manager in an ultra-luxury resort, ideally within remote or complex environments. ▪ Strong background in villa product operations with a high level of personalization and guest engagement. ▪ Demonstrated experience in sustainability-driven operations, with a clear understanding of regenerative practices. ▪ Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to drive revenue through premium positioning, guest experiences, and wellness offerings. ▪ Experience operating within highly competitive luxury markets, ideally within the Middle East region. ▪ Ability to manage complex logistics in remote environments, including supply chain, workforce, and operational challenges. ▪ Outstanding leadership capabilities, with a track record of building, inspiring, and retaining diverse teams in remote locations. ▪ Strong alignment with Six Senses and IHG luxury lifestyle philosophy and values. ▪ High level of guest engagement capability, with a focus on delivering exceptional and memorable experiences for high-net-worth clientele. ▪ Understanding of GCC guest profiles alongside international luxury travellers. ▪ Strong cultural awareness, with the ability to operate effectively within Omani traditions and regional sensitivities. ▪ Fluency in English is required; Arabic is preferred. ▪ Regional experience in the Middle East and familiarity with remote resort environments is highly advantageous. ▪ Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
